history.sg_progress: The Administration continues to make every effort to improve the accuracy of cost estimates. However, it is important to note that providing precise future cost estimates can be challenging, especially for projects in which the design phase has not been initiated. Accurate cost estimates are more achievable once the construction documents are completed, given that this allows for a more accurate assessment. Without the completion of the design phase, cost estimates are based on experience from previous similar projects and not on concrete project elements.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration take steps to more accurately forecast the estimated value of a contract as an additional element in the effective assessment of the reasonableness of quoted prices during the financial evaluation for the engineering, design and construction category.
history.administration_response: The Administration does not have any recently completed capital projects that would enable it to demonstrate, with concrete examples, the steps being taken to ensure a more accurate estimate. Given the liquidity situation, it is unlikely that the Administration will be able to obtain the funding required for such a project this year, especially considering that there are no approved projects under section 33 for 2025. The recommendation should therefore remain open, with a target implementation date of December 2026. This target date may be further delayed depending on the availability of funding for capital projects in 2026. The Administration would like to reiterate that the implementation of the other projects is contingent on the financial liquidity situation, which remains uncertain.
history.board_assessment: The Board has not received new information that would enable the closure of the recommendation on the grounds that it has either been implemented or overtaken by events. The Board cannot consider the recommendation to be overtaken by events because the lack of construction projects is temporary and related to the liquidity crisis.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration take steps to more accurately forecast the estimated value of a contract as an additional element in the effective assessment of the reasonableness of quoted prices during the financial evaluation for the engineering, design and construction category.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Administration will ensure that all estimates used for a solicitation exercise are based on a final design, which will lead to a more accurate estimate. However, it should be noted that providing precise cost estimates, especially for large construction projects, has proven to be very challenging given the complexities and unplanned changes that frequently arise during the implementation phase of such projects. The project to vacate the Falchi Building lease provides a good illustration of the estimation process.
history.board_assessment: The Board acknowledges the progress made in the estimation process through the example provided, and considers the recommendation to be implemented.
